notes: Page text with 'You said:' and 'ChatGPT said:' headers (synthetic).

Apple's share parser knows only 'You said:' and 'Claude responded:'. Every answer is appended to the question before it, all messages are user messages, and the session is labelled Claude. The web app also accepts 'ChatGPT said:', 'Gemini said:' and 'Claude said:' as assistant headers and takes the provider from the header family.
